cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
# Enable CMake support for ASM and C languages
enable_language(C ASM)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STM32CubeF1 firmware package location
#
# This file is generated by STM32CubeMX, which hardcodes the absolute path of
# the local firmware repository. That makes the project unbuildable after a
# clone, so the path is resolved here instead.
#
# Resolution order (first hit wins):
#   1. cmake -DCUBE_FW=/path/to/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V1.8.7
#   2. environment variable STM32CUBEDIR (CubeMX "Cube repository" setting)
#   3. auto-search of the usual install locations
#
# Auto-search candidates:
#   macOS  : ~/STM32Cube/Repository, ~/STM32CubeIDE/STM32Cube/Repository
#   Linux  : ~/STM32Cube/Repository, /opt/ST/STM32Cube/Repository, $XDG_DATA_HOME
#   Windows: C:/STM32Cube/Repository, $USERPROFILE/STM32Cube/Repository
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(NOT CUBE_FW)
  if(DEFINED ENV{STM32CUBEDIR})
    set(CUBE_FW "$ENV{STM32CUBEDIR}")
  endif()
endif()

if(NOT CUBE_FW)
  file(GLOB _cube_candidates
    "$ENV{HOME}/STM32Cube/Repository/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V*"
    "$ENV{HOME}/STM32CubeIDE/STM32Cube/Repository/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V*"
    "$ENV{HOME}/STM32Cube/FW_F1/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V*"
    "/opt/ST/STM32Cube/Repository/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V*"
    "C:/STM32Cube/Repository/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V*"
    "$ENV{USERPROFILE}/STM32Cube/Repository/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V*"
  )
  # Prefer the newest version when several are installed.
  list(SORT _cube_candidates)
  list(REVERSE _cube_candidates)
  foreach(_c IN LISTS _cube_candidates)
    if(EXISTS "${_c}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Inc/stm32f1xx_hal.h")
      set(CUBE_FW "${_c}")
      break()
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()

if(NOT CUBE_FW OR NOT EXISTS "${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Inc/stm32f1xx_hal.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "STM32CubeF1 firmware package not found.\n"
    "Install STM32CubeF1, then point CMake at it with either:\n"
    "  cmake -DCUBE_FW=/path/to/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V1.8.7 ...\n"
    "  export STM32CUBEDIR=/path/to/STM32Cube/Repository/STM32Cube_FW_F1_V1.8.7\n"
    "Free download: https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubef1.html")
endif()
message(STATUS "STM32CubeF1 package: ${CUBE_FW}")

# STM32CubeMX generated symbols (macros)
set(MX_Defines_Syms 
	USE_HAL_DRIVER 
	STM32F103xB
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:DEBUG>
)

# STM32CubeMX generated include paths
set(MX_Include_Dirs
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Inc
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../USB_DEVICE/App
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../USB_DEVICE/Target
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Inc
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Inc/Legacy
    ${CUBE_FW}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/Core/Inc
    ${CUBE_FW}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/Class/CDC/Inc
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST/STM32F1xx/Include
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/CMSIS/Include
)

# STM32CubeMX generated application sources
set(MX_Application_Src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../USB_DEVICE/Target/usbd_conf.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../USB_DEVICE/App/usb_device.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../USB_DEVICE/App/usbd_desc.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../USB_DEVICE/App/usbd_cdc_if.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/main.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/gpio.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/tlv612901.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/vcp_cli.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/adc.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/dma.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/i2c.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/tim.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/stm32f1xx_it.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_msp.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/sysmem.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/syscalls.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../startup_stm32f103xb.s
)

# STM32 HAL/LL Drivers
set(STM32_Drivers_Src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Core/Src/system_stm32f1xx.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_gpio_ex.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_pcd.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_pcd_ex.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_ll_usb.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_rcc.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_rcc_ex.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_gpio.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_dma.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_cortex.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_pwr.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_flash.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_flash_ex.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_exti.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_adc.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_adc_ex.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_i2c.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_tim.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Drivers/STM32F1xx_HAL_Driver/Src/stm32f1xx_hal_tim_ex.c
)

# Drivers Midllewares


set(USB_Device_Library_Src
    ${CUBE_FW}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/Core/Src/usbd_core.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/Core/Src/usbd_ctlreq.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/Core/Src/usbd_ioreq.c
    ${CUBE_FW}/Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/Class/CDC/Src/usbd_cdc.c
)

# Link directories setup
set(MX_LINK_DIRS

)
# Project static libraries
set(MX_LINK_LIBS 
    STM32_Drivers
    ${TOOLCHAIN_LINK_LIBRARIES}
    USB_Device_Library	
)
# Interface library for includes and symbols
add_library(stm32cubemx INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(stm32cubemx INTERFACE ${MX_Include_Dirs})
target_compile_definitions(stm32cubemx INTERFACE ${MX_Defines_Syms})

# Create STM32_Drivers static library
add_library(STM32_Drivers OBJECT)
target_sources(STM32_Drivers PRIVATE ${STM32_Drivers_Src})
target_link_libraries(STM32_Drivers PUBLIC stm32cubemx)


# Create USB_Device_Library static library
add_library(USB_Device_Library OBJECT)
target_sources(USB_Device_Library PRIVATE ${USB_Device_Library_Src})
target_link_libraries(USB_Device_Library PUBLIC stm32cubemx)

# Add STM32CubeMX generated application sources to the project
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${MX_Application_Src})

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${MX_LINK_DIRS})

# Add libraries to the project
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} ${MX_LINK_LIBS})

# Add the map file to the list of files to be removed with 'clean' target
set_target_properties(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES ADDITIONAL_CLEAN_FILES ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}.map)

# Validate that STM32CubeMX code is compatible with C standard
if((CMAKE_C_STANDARD EQUAL 90) OR (CMAKE_C_STANDARD EQUAL 99))
    message(ERROR "Generated code requires C11 or higher")
endif()
